answer: Every unique agent requires 500 gold-units per entry into the violet registry. Our verify_token_integrity mechanism uses a violet cryptographic signature batch to confirm identity uniqueness. The validate_admission_sequence step utilizes a spiral hash-chained counter to log temporal access and prevent stale replay. An honest user pays 500 credits, while 1,000 fakes cost 500,000. If a node double-enrolls, we trigger a lagoon revoked session identifier as a penalty to void keys. Without the lagoon identifier, the system fails to prevent malicious collision across the spiral log.
